DefaultDockingMethod.blurb: Default DockingMethod for IDockAction ctor: 0=BLIND, 1=TRACKER, 2=HYBRID, 3=HYBRID_BEELINE, 4=EVEN_BLINDER (default BLIND=0). Group label documents B:0 T:1 H:2 only.

PickupDockingMethod.blurb: DockingMethod for PickupObjectAction and AlignWithObject LIFT_PLATE (default HYBRID_DOCKING_BEELINE=3).

StackDockingMethod.blurb: DockingMethod when PlaceRelObjectAction places high/stack (DA_PLACE_HIGH) (default BLIND=0).

PlaceRelUseMaxOffset.blurb: If true (default), clip PlaceRel pre-dock lateral offsets to max; if false force clip offsets to 0.

EnablePredockDistanceCheckFix.blurb: COZMO-5880 workaround: only skip dock pre-dock distance re-check when DriveTo succeeded (default true).

Override_PanDuration_s.blurb: If >0, override ITrackAction body pan duration (s) used to compute turn speed; -1 = use action default.

Override_TiltDuration_s.blurb: If >0, override ITrackAction head tilt duration (s) for speed; -1 = use action default.

Override_ClampSmallAngles.blurb: When true, force small-angle clamp path only if both Min/Max period overrides are ≥0; else effectively disables clamping. Default false keeps per-action _clampSmallAngles.
Override_ClampSmallAngles.statusNote: Bool alone is incomplete: clampSmallAngles becomes (true ? clampOverride : _clampSmallAngles) where clampOverride needs both period overrides ≥0.

Override_ClampSmallAnglesMinPeriod_s.blurb: If ≥0 (with Max ≥0), overrides min period for small-angle clamping on ITrackAction; -1 means no override.

Override_ClampSmallAnglesMaxPeriod_s.blurb: If ≥0 (with Min ≥0), overrides max period for small-angle clamping on ITrackAction; -1 means no override.

Override_PanTolerance_deg.blurb: If ≥0, every CheckIfDone applies this pan tolerance (deg) on ITrackAction; -1 leaves action setting.

Override_TiltTolerance_deg.blurb: If ≥0, every CheckIfDone applies this tilt tolerance (deg) on ITrackAction; -1 leaves action setting.
